title: CoMPASS: Collaborative Molecular Property Prediction via Adaptive Small-Large Model Synergy
abstract: arXiv:2608.30674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate molecular property prediction requires both statistical reliability and chemical reasoning. Graph neural networks can be calibrated directly on labeled assays but remain limited by the coverage of their training data. Large language models (LLMs) can compare molecular evidence and articulate chemical rationales, yet are unreliable as standalone quantitative predictors. The central challenge is therefore to determine when an LLM should influence a calibrated model and by how much. Here we present CoMPASS, a retrieval-calibrated framework for small-large model collaboration. CoMPASS retains a graph attention network (GAT) as the predictive anchor, retrieves locally relevant training molecules, provides attention-grounded evidence to an LLM, and converts its proposal into a bounded correction through an agreement-aware gate. translated_title: CoMPASS：通过自适应小-大模型协同实现协作式分子性质预测
translated_abstract: 准确的分子性质预测既需要统计可靠性，也需要化学推理能力。图神经网络可以直接在带标签的实验数据上进行校准，但其性能受限于训练数据的覆盖范围。大型语言模型（LLM）能够比较分子证据并阐述化学原理，但作为独立的定量预测器并不可靠。因此，核心挑战在于确定LLM应在何时对已校准的模型产生影响，以及影响的程度有多大。我们提出了CoMPASS，一个用于小-大模型协作的检索校准框架。CoMPASS保留图注意力网络（GAT）作为预测锚点，检索局部相关的训练分子，向LLM提供基于注意力机制的证据支持，并通过一致性感知门控将LLM的建议转化为有界修正。在六个分类和两个回归基准测试中，CoMPASS在相关区域改进了GAT锚点的表现。
tldr: CoMPASS提出了一种检索校准的小-大模型协同框架，以图注意力网络为预测锚点，通过检索相关训练分子、向LLM提供注意力证据支持，并借助一致性感知门控将有界修正融入预测，从而提升分子性质预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: CoMPASS is a retrieval-calibrated framework that keeps a GAT as the predictive anchor, supplies attention-grounded evidence to an LLM, and applies bounded corrections through an agreement-aware gate, improving molecular property prediction across classification and regression benchmarks.
